# 1 Clement Chapter 32 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_032_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 32

**32:1** If anyone should examine these things carefully one by one, he will understand the magnificence of the gifts he has given.

**32:2** For from Jacob come all the priests and Levites who minister before the altar of God; from him according to the flesh comes the Lord Jesus Christ; from him spring the kings and rulers and governors in the line of Judah; and his remaining tribes are held in no small honor, since God said: "Your seed shall be as the stars of heaven."

**32:3** All of them were glorified and magnified, not through themselves or their own works or the righteous acts they accomplished, but through his will.

**32:4** And so we too, having been called by his will in Christ Jesus, are not justified through ourselves, nor through our own wisdom or understanding or piety or works which we have wrought in holiness of heart, but through faith, through which the Almighty God has justified all who have existed from the beginning; to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*LOGOS preserves the theological precision of v. 4 with careful attention to each term: justification, faith, Almighty God, from the beginning.*
